attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 18 Ιουλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and gives one sentence: «Ο Άγιος Μάρκελλος μαρτύρησε, αφού τον ξάπλωσαν πάνω σε πυρακτωμένο κρεβάτι, με αποτέλεσμα να ψηθεί ζωντανός» — he was laid on a red-hot bed and roasted alive. He is none of the corpus's nine other men of this name, and the one that needs saying is `marcellus-the-martyr-1-march`, who also dies by fire: that folder's Greek and Romanian rows both stand on 1 Μαρτίου, he is paired there with Antony, and the two of them are thrown into a fire rather than laid on a bed — two entries on one calendar are two commemorations. The others stand on 22 Μαΐου, 9 Φεβρουαρίου (Sicily), 14 Αυγούστου (Apamea), and with the Akoimetoi and the twelve tribunes. The name here is bare, so the day disambiguates the folder. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on this page; the day's «Άγιος Ιωάννης Θ' Πατριάρχης Κωνσταντινούπολης *» does carry it and is refused. No year, no place, no judge and no emperor is printed, so there is no `dates` object and no `locations`, and the page prints no hymn.
